sectionIntro: The Barn hosts live music most weekends, plus a few bigger outdoor shows on the lawn each year. Follow Facebook for the current lineup.

featured.title: Fall Festival: Boots & Brews
featured.body: Boots, brews, and live music by The Deloreans starting at 11 AM. One of the Barn's biggest days of the year. Bring the whole family out to the back lawn.

events.title: Karaoke with Mandy & Mitch
events.body: Grab the mic and be the star of the night. Saturdays, 7 to 10 PM.

events.title: Music Bingo
events.body: Music, prizes, and drinks. A hosted bingo night for the whole crew.

events.title: Food Truck Days
events.body: Local food trucks rotate through the lot to keep the menu fresh. Check Facebook to see who's parked out back this week.
